themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints spiked to 15 this week versus a baseline average of 0.8 per week—a 1900% increase with z-score 17.19—suggesting a sudden, acute problem with Uber/Lyft or similar services in Woodhaven/Richmond Hill that emerged only in the past 7 days.
evidence: 15 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 17.19)
This is the single largest statistical anomaly in the dataset by magnitude
No prior pattern suggests this is a new operational disruption or service issue
reporting_angles: What specific for-hire vehicle issue triggered 19x normal complaint volume this week? (parking, congestion, service outages, safety incidents?)
Interview residents about their experiences with Uber/Lyft and other services in the neighborhood

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints jumped to 123 this week compared to a 27.5 weekly average—a 347% spike with z-score 14.52—indicating rapid pavement, pothole, or drainage failures across Woodhaven/Richmond Hill in the past 7 days.
evidence: 123 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 27.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 14.52)
Second-highest z-score in dataset, indicating sustained infrastructure stress
Street condition is already the 6th-most-complained-about issue over 90 days (770 total), now dramatically accelerating
reporting_angles: Map the geographic hotspots of street complaints this week—are they concentrated in specific blocks or corridors?
Interview DOT about what triggered the sudden spike: pothole season, drainage failure, weather event?

themes_detail.label: Residential Noise Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints spiked to 110 last week versus a baseline of 59.6 per week—an 84% increase with z-score 5.2—marking a sharp uptick in residential disturbances over the past 7–14 days.
evidence: 110 noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 59.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.2)
Noise is the 5th most-complained-about issue overall (849 in 90 days); this spike suggests a recent trigger
Timing suggests possible correlation with weather, construction permits, or venue/event activity
reporting_angles: What is driving the noise spike—new bars/restaurants, construction projects, illegal events, or summer activity uptick?
Interview affected residents and NYPD about patterns: timing of day, neighborhoods affected, source types

themes_detail.label: Traffic Signal Malfunction Wave
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal complaints jumped to 135 two weeks ago versus a 27.0 weekly average—a 400% spike with z-score 5.02—indicating a widespread signal outage or maintenance failure affecting traffic safety and flow in the district.
evidence: 135 traffic signal complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 27.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.02)
Traffic signal condition is normally the 7th-most-complained issue; this spike is statistically significant
Potential safety hazard if signals are malfunctioning at high-traffic intersections
reporting_angles: Which intersections had signal failures 2 weeks ago? Were they coordinated/systemic (power outage, software glitch) or scattered?
Interview DOT about repair timeline and whether signal maintenance is being deferred or understaffed

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Proliferation
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked to 11 two weeks ago versus a 1.4 weekly average—a 700% spike with z-score 6.83—suggesting rapid or unauthorized cannabis shop openings or expansion of existing retail operations in Woodhaven/Richmond Hill.
evidence: 11 cannabis retailer complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.83)
Cannabis retail is normally near-silent in 311 data; this spike indicates a sudden neighborhood concern
Aligns with ongoing NYC legal cannabis retail rollout; this district may be facing licensing or enforcement issues
reporting_angles: How many licensed cannabis retailers have opened in Woodhaven/Richmond Hill in the past month? Are there illegal shops?
Interview residents about concerns: youth access, odor, loitering, zoning violations, or lack of community input on retail siting
